figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT warehouse_id,p.category_id,SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type='sale' THEN -quantity_delta*unit_cost_cents WHEN movement_type='return' THEN -quantity_delta*unit_cost_cents ELSE 0 END) cogs FROM stock_movements m JOIN products p ON p.product_id=m.product_id WHERE movement_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,p.category_id), b AS (SELECT w.warehouse_id,c.category_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(i.snapshot_id)=2*COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) THEN SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents)/2.0 ELSE NULL END avg_stock FROM warehouses w CROSS JOIN categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id=c.category_id LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id AND i.product_id=p.product_id AND i.snapshot_date IN ('2024-12-31','2025-12-31') GROUP BY w.warehouse_id,c.category_id) SELECT b.warehouse_id,b.category_id,COALESCE(a.cogs,0) cogs_cents,b.avg_stock avg_stock_cents,ROUND(COALESCE(a.cogs,0)/NULLIF(b.avg_stock,0),4) turnover,CASE WHEN a.cogs>0 THEN ROUND(365.0*b.avg_stock/a.cogs,2) ELSE NULL END turnover_days FROM b LEFT JOIN a ON a.warehouse_id=b.warehouse_id AND a.category_id=b.category_id ORDER BY cogs_cents DESC

parts.label: 中间结果
parts.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT warehouse_id,p.category_id,SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type='sale' THEN -quantity_delta*unit_cost_cents WHEN movement_type='return' THEN -quantity_delta*unit_cost_cents ELSE 0 END) cogs FROM stock_movements m JOIN products p ON p.product_id=m.product_id WHERE movement_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,p.category_id),
parts.note: 先单独算出一张临时结果 a，下面的查询可以把它当作普通表来用。

parts.label: 中间结果
parts.sql: b AS (SELECT w.warehouse_id,c.category_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(i.snapshot_id)=2*COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) THEN SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents)/2.0 ELSE NULL END avg_stock FROM warehouses w CROSS JOIN categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id=c.category_id LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id AND i.product_id=p.product_id AND i.snapshot_date IN ('2024-12-31','2025-12-31') GROUP BY w.warehouse_id,c.category_id)
parts.note: 先单独算出一张临时结果 b，下面的查询可以把它当作普通表来用。

parts.label: 取数
parts.sql: SELECT b.warehouse_id,b.category_id,COALESCE(a.cogs,0) cogs_cents,b.avg_stock avg_stock_cents,ROUND(COALESCE(a.cogs,0)/NULLIF(b.avg_stock,0),4) turnover,CASE WHEN a.cogs>0 THEN ROUND(365.0*b.avg_stock/a.cogs,2) ELSE NULL END turnover_days

parts.label: 来源
parts.sql: FROM b LEFT JOIN a ON a.warehouse_id=b.warehouse_id AND a.category_id=b.category_id
parts.note: 数据来自 中间结果 b、中间结果 a，并用 ON 后面的条件把它们的行配起来。

parts.label: 排序
parts.note: 按 cogs_cents DESC 排列结果。

figures.title: 库存周转率
figures.meaning: 衡量库存周转的快慢：销售成本相对于平均库存成本越大，库存周转得越快。
figures.interpretation: 库存周转率 {result}：这段时间的销售成本是平均库存成本的这么多倍；数值越大，库存周转越快。

notes.label: 零值
notes.text: 无销售成本且库存为正时周转率为0、天数未定义

notes.label: 易错口径
notes.text: 用期末售价金额作分母，或者把缺失快照填零
分母为 0 时，结果为空（NULL），不会报错，也不会写成 0。

figures.title: 周转天数
figures.meaning: 把周转率换算成天数：库存平均要多少天才能周转一次。
figures.interpretation: 周转天数 {result}：库存平均要这么多天才能周转一次；天数越小，周转越快。
